figures.name: Murugan

ability.name: Vel Spear
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one enemy; if demon type, deal 12 damage.

figures.description: The uniquely Tamil god of war and divine youth who wields the Vel spear and rides a peacock.

figures.name: Korravai

ability.name: Victory Dance
ability.description: After any enemy is defeated, all allies gain +2 power from Korravai's war dance.

figures.description: The fierce Tamil war goddess who dances on the battlefield in victory, ancestor of the pan-Indian Kali.

figures.name: Kannagi

ability.name: Chastity's Fire
ability.description: Deal 6 fire damage to the most powerful enemy from absolute righteous rage.

figures.description: The wronged wife of Silappathikaram who burned the city of Madurai with her righteous fury.

figures.name: Valli

ability.name: Forest Grace
ability.description: Grant one ally +3 to all stats from the grace of unconditional love.

figures.description: The tribal hunter girl who became one of Murugan's wives through the god's persistent and tricky courtship.

figures.name: Thirumal (Vishnu)

ability.name: Southern Vishnu
ability.description: All Tamil and Dravidian allies gain +2 to all stats from southern divine power.

figures.description: The Tamil form of Vishnu worshipped in the Sangam tradition with a distinctly southern identity.

figures.name: Agastya

ability.name: Southern Mission
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 wisdom; enemy mountain or barrier abilities are nullified.

figures.description: The great sage who crossed the Vindhya mountains, calming them forever, and created Tamil grammar.

figures.name: Seyon

ability.name: Red Hill God
ability.description: All hill and mountain allies gain +3 power; deal 5 damage to demon enemies.

figures.description: Ancient Dravidian red god of the hills whose identification with Murugan is one of the oldest religious fusions.

figures.name: Senguttuvan

ability.name: Chera's Honor
ability.description: Grant one ally a permanent +2 to defense from the honor of a king.

figures.description: The Chera king who honored the chaste Kannagi by bringing stone from the Himalayas to carve her image.

figures.name: Mayon

ability.name: Black God's Grace
ability.description: Charm one enemy with divine flute music; they cannot attack for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Tamil form of Krishna as the dark-skinned cowherd god worshipped in pastoral Sangam traditions.

figures.name: Murukan's Peacock

ability.name: Peacock Strike
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all demon enemies; they are blinded for 1 turn.

figures.description: Murugan's divine peacock mount who defeated the demon Surapadma and became eternally loyal to the war god.

figures.name: Siddhar

ability.name: Siddha Power
ability.description: Grant one ally a permanent +1 to all stats from Siddha mastery.

figures.description: One of the 18 Tamil Siddha masters who attained immortality and supernatural powers through yoga and alchemy.

figures.name: Idumban

ability.name: Hill Bearer
ability.description: This card can carry another ally: protect them from all damage for 1 turn.

figures.description: The demon who became Murugan's devotee after being defeated and is now the keeper of Murugan's twin hills.

figures.name: Vel Spear Spirit

ability.name: Unerring Light
ability.description: This card's attack cannot be blocked, dodged or redirected by any means.

figures.description: The spirit of Murugan's divine Vel spear given by Parvati, which flies unerringly to destroy all demons.

figures.name: Surapadman

ability.name: Split Demon
ability.description: When this card is destroyed, split into two half-power versions that attack separately.

figures.description: The great demon king who ruled the three worlds and was split by Murugan's Vel, half becoming his peacock mount.

figures.name: Ainkurunuru Spirit

ability.name: Tinai Harmony
ability.description: Match terrain to warrior: allied cards gain +2 to all stats in their native landscape type.

figures.description: The spirit of the Sangam Tinai system linking specific gods, landscapes and emotions in Tamil poetic geography.

figures.name: Pari

ability.name: Patron's Gift
ability.description: Grant one ally +2 to all stats from the generosity of the patron.

figures.description: The legendary generous Tamil chieftain who gave his chariot to a jasmine vine to support it.

figures.name: Neytal Deity

ability.name: Coastal Longing
ability.description: Inflict longing on one enemy: they are distracted and lose 2 speed for 1 turn.

figures.description: The deity of the seashore landscape presiding over love's patient waiting and the sorrow of separation.

figures.name: Kudal Azhakar

ability.name: Temple Pillar
ability.description: While in play, all Tamil allies gain +1 defense per turn.

figures.description: The particular Vishnu of the Madurai temple whose local name and form are uniquely Tamil.

figures.name: Eeyar

ability.name: Forest Tiger
ability.description: All forest and nature enemies flee from this card: they cannot use ambush abilities.

figures.description: The sacred tiger of the Sangam literature's mountainous Kurinchi landscape representing heroic valor.

figures.name: Pandian King

ability.name: Meenakshi's Banner
ability.description: All Tamil warrior allies gain +1 power per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The archetypal Pandya king under whose fish banner the Tamil nation flourished for centuries.
